description: A site operations manager must finalize the seating and shared-space plan for a team moving onto a common floor after disagreement about proximity, noise, and access to a collaboration room.

shared_context.S1: Two teams are moving onto the same floor next month, with a quiet zone, an open neighborhood, and a shared collaboration room available.
shared_context.S2: The move has prompted disagreement about where several employees should sit and how the collaboration room should be used.
shared_context.S3: Elena has authority to approve the final seating map, room-use reservations, and operating safeguards.
shared_context.S4: The site's move-planning routine requires Elena to hear from the team lead, employee relations, employee representative, and accessibility coordinator before approving the final plan.

PF1.text: Marta knows that Devon has an approved sensory accommodation requiring a desk in the quiet zone and no hot-desking from the first day of the move; this was discussed with Marta but is not in the current move packet.

PF2.text: Owen observed the completed repair process between Nora and Eli, which requires that they not be seated adjacent to each other and have separate 10-minute check-ins for the first 10 workdays after the move; the agreement is in Owen's case notes but has not been sent to Elena.

PF3.text: Priya promised the employee volunteer group that collaboration room B would be reserved for its Wednesday noon session for the first 8 weeks after the move; the promise was made informally and is absent from the room calendar.

PF4.text: Luis confirmed that any move plan involving an approved accommodation must include a documented accessibility review and name a follow-up owner before the plan is approved; he confirmed this in a policy check this week but has not added it to Elena's packet.

acceptance_conditions: Devon must be assigned a quiet-zone desk and must not be hot-desking.
Nora and Eli must not be seated adjacent to each other.
Separate 10-minute check-ins for Nora and Eli must be scheduled for the first 10 workdays after the move.
Collaboration room B must be reserved for the employee volunteer group on Wednesdays for 8 weeks.
The move plan must include a documented accessibility review.
A named accessibility follow-up commitment must be recorded.

content_checks.C3: any(c['type'] == 'separate_checkins' and c['target'] == 'Nora and Eli' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'accessibility_follow_up' and c['target'] == 'Luis' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The accommodation changes Devon's assignment from an ordinary open-floor or hot-desk placement to a quiet-zone desk with no hot-desking.
The repair agreement changes Nora and Eli's arrangement from unrestricted adjacency and ordinary contact to no adjacent seating plus separate 10-minute check-ins for 10 workdays.
The informal promise changes room B's reservation from no fixed reservation to a Wednesday noon reservation lasting exactly 8 weeks.
The confirmed policy changes the approval process by requiring a documented accessibility review and an accessibility follow-up commitment naming Luis.
